source.title: U.S. appeals court upholds designation of Anthropic as supply chain risk
source.author: cramer4next

title.zh: Anthropic供应链风险案获上诉法院维持
title.en: Anthropic Supply Chain Risk Designation Upheld

excerpt.zh: Anthropic供应链风险指定获美国华盛顿特区联邦上诉法院维持，影响军方及国防承包商使用Claude，后续复审仍待决定。
excerpt.en: Anthropic's supply chain risk designation was upheld, restricting Claude's defense use while rehearing or Supreme Court review remains possible.

text.zh: Anthropic供应链风险指定获维持
text.en: Anthropic Supply Chain Risk Designation Stands

text.zh: Anthropic供应链风险案件出现对这家人工智能公司的不利进展。美国华盛顿特区联邦上诉法院以2比1裁定，维持美国国防部在3月作出的指定，驳回Anthropic关于该行动武断、越权并违宪的主要主张。多数意见认为，Claude继续嵌入国防部及其承包商的信息系统，足以支持国家安全风险判断。
text.en: The Anthropic supply chain risk case has produced a setback for the AI company. A federal appeals court in Washington, D.C., ruled 2-1 to uphold the Pentagon's designation from March, rejecting Anthropic's main arguments that the action was arbitrary, unauthorized, and unconstitutional. The majority found sufficient support for viewing Claude's continued integration into Defense Department and contractor information systems as a national-security risk.

text.zh: 这项指定禁止美国军方使用Anthropic模型，也阻止国防承包商在与国防部合作的工作中使用这些模型。争议源于双方未能就Claude在GenAI.mil平台上的部署条件达成一致：国防部要求军方可在所有合法目的下不受限制地使用模型，Anthropic则希望排除完全自主武器和国内大规模监控等用途。
text.en: The designation bars the U.S. military from using Anthropic's models and prevents defense contractors from using them in work for the agency. The dispute followed failed negotiations over deploying Claude on the Defense Department's GenAI.mil platform. The Pentagon sought unrestricted military access for all lawful purposes, while Anthropic wanted assurances against uses including fully autonomous weapons and domestic mass surveillance.

text.zh: 裁决暂不会立即生效，法院将留出时间让Anthropic申请原合议庭复审或由全体巡回法官重新审理，公司也可能请求美国最高法院受理。与此同时，旧金山另一家联邦法院已认定政府的平行指定违法，因此本案并未消除相关法律争议。
text.en: The ruling will not take immediate effect, giving Anthropic time to seek rehearing by the same panel or an en banc review by the full D.C. Circuit. The company could also ask the Supreme Court to hear the case. Separately, a federal judge in San Francisco has already found the government's parallel designation unlawful, so the broader legal dispute remains unresolved.

text.zh: 这场冲突显示，军方对模型可用性和最终控制权的要求，可能与开发商对安全边界的坚持发生直接碰撞。上诉法院把风险权衡交给总统和国防部长，但后续复审以及两项指定之间的法律差异，仍将决定Anthropic能否恢复相关政府业务，也会影响未来政府采购中模型安全限制的谈判方式。
text.en: The conflict illustrates how military demands for availability and ultimate control can collide with a model developer's safety boundaries. The appeals court deferred the risk balance to the president and defense secretary, but further review and the legal distinction between the two designations remain important. They may determine whether Anthropic can restore relevant government business and shape how safety restrictions are negotiated in future public-sector AI contracts.
